title: spec(ui): the bound record blocks (`record:details` / `record:highlights` / `record:quick_actions`) accept no authored `emptyState`, so a 0-row binding draws only the renderer placeholder (objectui#12932)
body:
**Filing gate ④:** the `packages/spec` half of a ruled renderer card. Filed by the triage seat (objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015, `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U`) on the `domain:ui` seat 1's retriage request on objectstack-ai/objectui#12932, which asked that the spec half be filed here first, by cross-repo rule 2 and the maintainer's standing 「平台相关的功能，应该尽量先改平台。」 ⛔ Not a claim.

**Pull (ruled):** objectstack-ai/cloud#2774 Q2 = **B**, the maintainer's 「同意」 on director batch #362. The control plane's environment record blocks must draw an authored empty state when their bound `dataSource` yields no row (an organisation with no production environment today sees a raw "record not found").

**Reader who acts:** the `domain:spec` seat, one PR on `packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts`.

## Measured on `origin/main`

- `RecordDetailsProps` (`component.zod.ts:1255`), `RecordHighlightsProps` (`:1884`) and `RecordQuickActionsProps` (`:2318`) are all `strictObject` with no `emptyState`. An authored `emptyState` on any of them is refused today.
- The one `emptyState` in the file is `ObjectGridPropsSchema`'s (`:4870`, `EmptyStateSchema.optional()`), the shape precedent (#20694).
- objectui's `packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/recordBinding.tsx` (objectui `main` `79cb8c03eb`) names exactly these three bound record blocks and their 0-row draws: "record not found", nothing, and "no actions configured".

## The work

- Each of the three props gains `emptyState: EmptyStateSchema.optional()` by reference, ⛔ not a re-spelled shape. Its describe says it is drawn when the block's bound `dataSource` yields no row, and only then.
- `Clause-②: yes (widening)`, a `minor` changeset, and one contract-tier review.
- objectui#12932's "four record blocks": the three above are the bound set `recordBinding.tsx` names. A fourth is added only if this seat finds another block bound the same way.

## Order

objectstack-ai/objectui#12932 (the renderer half) is `pm:blocked` on this card. It dispatches once this key is in the `@objectstack/spec` objectui installs.

## Dedupe

The 1000 most recently updated objectstack-ai/objectstack items were enumerated over REST (543 issues, #2776–#24264; control #24162 found) and grepped for `emptyState` beside `record:details|highlights|quick_actions`: 0 hits.
